name: Azaries (Ahnor)
source:
In her Ahnor form, Azaries retains the same colors she has as an Om'veri. Her eyes remain purple, the same color as her main crystals. Her earlobes, chest, and "crown" are golden. Her body is silvery, and her "dress" is dark green.
Azaries-Ahnor retains the same personality she had in her life as an Om'veri. However, the status of a royal—the highest caste in Ahnor society—has clouded her mind, leading her to perceive Alveces more as her servant than as a friend.
